title: Callahan hides a copy of the JAL 1628 radar data from the CIA

tellings.quote: Callahan copied them and put them in a box that he placed under the table.

plain: When the CIA came for the radar records of Japan Air Lines flight 1628, whose crew had reported an unknown object, an official of the FAA named John Callahan is said to have copied the records first and hidden the copies in a box under the table. The researcher Kevin Knuth tells Michels this as he heard it from Callahan, as an example of evidence that would otherwise have been taken away and kept from the public.
